title: Apartment Transfer Fee Share after a Change in Care Needs (Assisted Living)
content:
Under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement, a move that follows a change in care needs is charged a reduced share of the transfer fee. Two facts are read from the records:

- **(a)** the residency has a change-of-condition or post-hospital reassessment completed in the 2 whole months before the handling date;
- **(b)** the ledger carries a care fee charge on the prorated level change basis for the current billing month, the billing month of the most recent full-month rent charge.

| (a) | (b) | Share of the transfer fee |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.5 |
| Yes | No | 0.75 |
| No | Yes | 0.75 |
| No | No | No reduction under this rule |

The share multiplies the transfer fee before it is rounded once to the cent.

**The 2-month window.** A reassessment counts when fewer than 2 whole months separate its assessment date from the handling date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the assessment date: with a hypothetical handling date of 15 August, a post-hospital reassessment on 16 June counts and one on 15 June does not. Routine and post-move-in reassessments do not count for (a).
